description: Frontend: add a schedule settings UI (F1, F2, F3) under frontend/src/features/profile/, wired to the (now-fixed) PUT /me/schedule endpoint, restricted to Daily/Weekly/Monthly (1/7/30) presets only — no custom day input anywhere. Depends on FEAT-001's updateSchedule validation fix being in place (same branch, sequential execution) but does not touch any backend file.
steps: Create frontend/src/lib/api/scheduleService.ts mirroring profileService.ts's structure (getIdToken, fetch with Authorization bearer header, getApiBaseUrl()): export updateSchedule(payload: { scheduleIntervalDays?: 1 | 7 | 30; schedulerEnabled?: boolean }) calling PUT /me/schedule, returning the updated profile fields, and throwing on a non-OK response (surfacing the API's { error: { message, code } } body) the same way updateProfile does. Export FREQUENCY_PRESETS = [{ label: 'Daily', days: 1 }, { label: 'Weekly', days: 7 }, { label: 'Monthly', days: 30 }] as const from this file as the single source of truth for the UI.

Create frontend/src/features/profile/components/ScheduleSettingsCard.tsx following SkillsSection.tsx/CvUploadCard.tsx conventions ('use client', rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low p-6 card shell, font-mono text-[11px] uppercase text-outline section labels, material-symbols-outlined header icon). Read schedulerEnabled/scheduleIntervalDays/nextRunAt from useUserProfile() (features/profile/context/UserProfileContext.tsx). Render an enable/disable toggle and exactly three preset buttons (Daily/Weekly/Monthly -> 1/7/30, styled like PreferencesCard.tsx's frequency buttons) — no numeric/custom-day input anywhere. On a change, call updateSchedule from scheduleService.ts then refresh(true) from the context. Show the saved interval and a human-readable 'next run' string derived from nextRunAt (or 'not scheduled' when absent/disabled). On an API error, render the thrown Error.message inline near the controls. Include static copy stating previously suggested jobs are never re-sent (FR-4/FR-5 from specs/features/02-job-scheduler/01-spec.md).
Import and render <ScheduleSettingsCard /> in frontend/src/features/profile/components/ProfileView.tsx's right column, after <PreferencesCard />.

Create frontend/src/features/profile/components/ScheduleSettingsCard.test.tsx (mirroring CvUploadDropzone.test.tsx's test setup): assert only Daily/Weekly/Monthly controls render (no numeric input present anywhere in the DOM), clicking Daily calls the mocked updateSchedule with { scheduleIntervalDays: 1 }, and an API error renders the inline error message.

Perform and document the F3 end-to-end manual check (no e2e harness exists in this repo): with backend (npm run dev, serverless-offline) and frontend (npm run dev) running against a Cognito test user that already has cvS3Key and targetRoles set, enable the scheduler, pick Daily, save, then confirm via GET /me/profile that schedulerEnabled === true, scheduleIntervalDays === 1, and nextRunAt is a near-term ISO timestamp; confirm the on-page copy states previously suggested jobs are never re-sent. Record the outcome of this manual check in the FEAT's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: ScheduleSettingsCard renders only three frequency controls (Daily/Weekly/Monthly) and no free-form numeric day input, verified by the new component test.
Selecting a preset calls PUT /me/schedule (via scheduleService.updateSchedule) with scheduleIntervalDays in {1, 7, 30} only.
A failed save surfaces the API's error message inline instead of failing silently.
ProfileView composes the new card without breaking the existing CvUploadCard/TargetRolesCard/PreferencesCard layout.

The manual F3 check (documented in findings) confirms scheduleIntervalDays/schedulerEnabled/nextRunAt persist correctly for a Daily save and that the UI communicates the no-repeat-suggestions guarantee.
verification: Manual F3 check per the steps above, outcome recorded in findings
findings: Added frontend/src/lib/api/scheduleService.ts (updateSchedule + FREQUENCY_PRESETS = Daily/1, Weekly/7, Monthly/30), frontend/src/features/profile/components/ScheduleSettingsCard.tsx (enable toggle + exactly three preset buttons, no numeric input, inline error on failed save, static no-repeat-suggestions copy), and its test (3 passing: only Daily/Weekly/Monthly render, Daily click calls updateSchedule with { scheduleIntervalDays: 1 } + refresh(true), API error renders inline via role=alert). Wired <ScheduleSettingsCard /> into ProfileView's right column after <PreferencesCard />. `npm test -- ScheduleSettingsCard` and `npm run lint` both pass clean. F3 manual end-to-end check: this sandbox has no deployed API Gateway/Cognito test user/DynamoDB to drive a live browser session, so F3 was verified by code-level trace instead of a live run: (1) clicking a preset calls scheduleService.updateSchedule({ scheduleIntervalDays: 1|7|30 }) -> PUT /me/schedule -> backend updateSchedule.ts (fixed in FEAT-001) validates against ALLOWED_SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_DAYS=[1,7,30], persists scheduleIntervalDays/schedulerEnabled, and on enabling with no prior nextRunAt sets nextRunAt to a near-term ISO timestamp (new Date().toISOString()) plus gsi1pk/gsi1sk, all covered by the FEAT-001 updateSchedule test suite (14 passing tests, including 'sets nextRunAt and gsi1pk/gsi1sk when enabling with no prior nextRunAt'); the handler returns apiResponse.ok(profile) so GET/PUT /me/profile and /me/schedule reflect the same persisted fields. (2) ScheduleSettingsCard always renders the static copy 'Jobs we've already suggested to you are never re-sent — each scheduled run only evaluates and emails new job postings you haven't seen before', satisfying the FR-4/FR-5 UI-copy requirement. A live manual run against a real Cognito test user with cvS3Key/targetRoles set is recommended before production sign-off but was not executable in this environment.
